title: Minimum Replay Projection Design v1
design_principles: JSON/JSONL remain the portable, inspectable, replayable source-of-truth. ReceiptStore sharded JSON files + manifest.jsonl are the canonical evidence artifacts.
DuckDB is the disposable analytical/read-side substrate. Use it for ad-hoc queries, cockpit projections, procurement evidence packs, and replay verification.
PostgreSQL is the future enterprise operational substrate. Postgres tables should mirror DuckDB views; migration from DuckDB→Postgres should be a column-mapped COPY.
Content-light always: no raw prompts, completions, private repo content, secrets, credentials, raw diffs, or raw Actions logs in any projection.

Manifest.jsonl enrichment is the P0 unlock: adding 5 fields (governance_decision_id, decision_status, surface, authority_tier, capability_id) to manifest enables most replay queries without reading all envelope files.
DuckDB projection is the P1 acceleration: once manifest is enriched, a DuckDB governance_decisions table enables SQL queries, dashboards, and export
Nothing in this design requires Postgres, hosted mode, or non-local dependencies. DuckDB reads files directly from the filesystem.
The projection is read-only. It never mutates source-of-truth artifacts.
queries_answered: Why was this operation blocked? — SELECT decision_id, reason_codes, blocked_intents, surface, tool_name FROM governance_decisions WHERE decision = 'blocked' AND governance_decision_id = ?
Which governance decisions happened in this session? — SELECT * FROM governance_decisions WHERE session_id = ? ORDER BY created_at DESC
Which CLI/MCP/GitHub operations produced decisions? — SELECT surface, capability_id, COUNT(*) FROM governance_decisions GROUP BY surface, capability_id
Which decisions failed because evidence could not persist? — SELECT * FROM governance_decisions WHERE evidence_persisted = False
Which mutation attempts were blocked/reviewed/executed? — SELECT decision, authority_tier, COUNT(*) FROM governance_decisions WHERE authority_tier LIKE '%mutation%' GROUP BY decision, authority_tier
Which surfaces are generating receipts? — SELECT surface, COUNT(*) FROM governance_decisions GROUP BY surface

Which receipts are missing common-envelope fields? — SELECT envelope_id, 'missing_request_id' FROM governance_decisions WHERE request_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT envelope_id, 'missing_content_light_classification' FROM governance_decisions WHERE content_light_classification IS NULL

manifest_enrichment_spec.backward_compatible: new fields appended after created_at; existing parsers skip unknown fields; manifest remains JSONL (append-only, line-by-line)

duckdb_governance_decisions_table.description: DuckDB read-side table sourced from ReceiptStore manifest.jsonl + sharded JSON envelope files. Rebuilt on demand from source-of-truth artifacts. Disposable: can be dropped and rebuilt at any time from JSONL + JSON.
duckdb_governance_decisions_table.build_query: SELECT * FROM read_json_auto('manifest.jsonl') LEFT JOIN read_json_auto('envelopes/**/*.json') ON manifest.envelope_id = envelope.envelope_id

postgres_future_governance_decisions_vie.description: PostgreSQL materialized view for enterprise operational substrate (P3). Mirrors DuckDB table structure with identical column names and types. Populated from ReceiptStore manifest + envelope import. JSONL source-of-truth is authoritative; Postgres view is a projection.
postgres_future_governance_decisions_vie.migration_path: DuckDB table → PostgreSQL table via COPY (Parquet/CSV intermediary). ReceiptStore manifest.jsonl can be imported as CSV. Envelope JSON files can be parsed via json_each(). Dual-write: ReceiptStore append also writes to Postgres when adapter exists.
